summary: An undergraduate computer science reader who knows asymptotic notation, basic discrete mathematics, linear algebra over the reals and complex numbers, elementary algebra (groups, rings, modular arithmetic, polynomials), elementary number theory (primes, CRT) and basic probability/combinatorics. They know basic Turing machines and tapes and the schoolbook and Karatsuba multiplication, and probably the FFT as an algorithm. They have not studied multitape-machine algorithm engineering, Schönhage–Strassen or later multiplication algorithms, or specialist linear-algebra constructions such as Bruhat factorizations.

known.name: Binary representation and bit operations
known.gloss: Writing integers as strings of bits, with bitwise XOR and counting of set bits (Hamming weight).

known.name: Modular arithmetic and congruences
known.gloss: Arithmetic on integers modulo m, where values are residues and addition and multiplication wrap around.

known.name: Primes and divisibility
known.gloss: Prime numbers, greatest common divisors, coprimality, and the fact that primes are plentiful enough to choose from.

known.name: Linear algebra over fields
known.gloss: Vectors, matrices, linear maps, subspaces, rank and invertibility, including matrix groups such as GL.

known.name: Permutations and bijections
known.gloss: Bijective rearrangements of a finite set of indices, composed and inverted.

known.name: Groups and rings (basic algebra)
known.gloss: Sets with associative operations, identities and inverses, and rings with addition and multiplication.

known.name: Finite sets and elementary combinatorics
known.gloss: Counting subsets, intersections and binomial coefficients.

known.name: Floating and fixed-point approximation and rounding
known.gloss: Approximating real numbers with finite precision, and bounding accumulated error by sums of absolute errors.

known.name: Recurrences and divide-and-conquer analysis
known.gloss: Bounding the running time of recursive algorithms via recurrences and summing geometric series.

known.name: Logarithms and exponentials
known.gloss: Properties of logarithms and exponentials, with lg meaning log base 2.

known.name: Fast Fourier transform algorithm
known.gloss: The O(n log n) divide-and-conquer evaluation of a polynomial at roots of unity.

known.name: Schoolbook and Karatsuba multiplication
known.gloss: Elementary quadratic and divide-and-conquer integer multiplication algorithms.

known.name: Floor, ceiling and big-omega notation
known.gloss: Rounding down or up, and companion asymptotic notations to big-O.
